Unknown command: -h
Usage: reml <command> [args]
Commands:
  parse <file>                 Parse and print config as JSON
  validate <file>              Validate file, print errors if any
  to-json <file>               Convert .reml to JSON
  emit <file>                  Emit evaluated config as REML text snapshot
  encode <file> [out.remlb]    Encode evaluated config as REML binary
  decode <file.remlb>          Decode binary snapshot to REML text (stdout)
  decode --json <file.remlb>   Decode binary snapshot to JSON
  format <file>                Format to canonical REML (stdout)
  format --check <file>        Exit 1 if file needs formatting
  format --write <file>        Overwrite file with formatted output
  format -o <out> <file>       Write formatted output to path
